registration.title: Create Your Identity
registration.welcome: Mess&Anger is decentralized. Your identity lives only on your device. We'll generate a recovery phrase — write it down and keep it safe.
registration.secureNote: All keys are generated locally. No data leaves your device.
registration.writeDown: Write these 24 words down in order. Never share them. This is the only way to recover your identity.
registration.typePhrase: Type your 24-word recovery phrase to confirm you saved it.
registration.phraseMismatch: The phrase doesn't match. Please check and try again.
registration.pinDescription: Optional but recommended. Adds a layer of protection when someone opens your device.
registration.pinError: PINs must match and be 4-6 digits.
registration.ready: Your secure identity is ready. Keep your recovery phrase safe — you'll need it if you switch devices.
registration.generateError: Failed to generate identity. Please try again.

login.restoreSubtitle: Enter your recovery phrase to restore your identity on this device.

login.restoreError: An error occurred during restoration. Please try again.
login.pinDescription: Optional but recommended. Adds a layer of protection when someone opens your device.

login.ready: Your identity has been restored. You can now start messaging securely.
